scope: catalog and opt-in selection for the existing versioned tier-0 diagnostics

checks.catalog: list exactly 27 existing unique IDs with their channel and unit without opening a trace
checks.compatibility: the default program and API preserve prior rows and order; selected output equals a stable subsequence of default output
checks.selection: check multiple channels, valid, unsupported, insufficient_data and budget_exceeded rows, idempotent duplicate selections, and unknown IDs rejected before reading
checks.validation: selected evaluation still reads the whole trace, validates fixed-site shape, and rejects malformed suffixes
checks.install: repeat the checks on Linux x86-64, Linux arm64 and macOS arm64 and exercise the public catalog from the installed package

limits: fixed built-in tier-0 catalog; dependency scheduling, artifact cache, scientific estimators and calibration are outside this slice
